dps.intro: Guild Wars 2 has no combat API. The only tool ArenaNet tolerates for reading combat data is ArcDPS, which shows live DPS in its own window inside the game and writes a log when the fight is over. This module reads those logs and gives you damage per player, boon uptime, comparison and upload to dps.report. The numbers arrive a few seconds after the fight ends, not during it.
dps.step1: Install ArcDPS with the button below. The app downloads the file from the publisher's official address, verifies the checksum and puts it in the game folder. ArcDPS cannot be bundled with the app, the publisher does not allow it, and the file must be updated after every game patch.
dps.step2: Start the game. Press Alt+Shift+T for the ArcDPS menu, go to the Logging tab and enable logging. You only need to do this once.
dps.step3: Fight. The log ends up in Documents\Guild Wars 2\addons\arcdps\arcdps.cbtlogs, and appears here automatically.
dps.pickLog: Pick a log, or wait for the next fight.

dps.uploadTitle: Uploads the log to dps.report and opens the report. Sends the file to an external service.
dps.footnote: Damage is direct plus condition damage against enemies, with pets and minions credited to their owner. Boon uptime is simplified (no stack limit). Healing requires the ArcDPS Healing Stats addon and is not included yet.
live.bridgeHelp: The bridge is our own ArcDPS extension (arcdps_gw2overlay_bridge.dll). It lives in the game folder next to d3d11.dll and sends combat events to the overlay. Requires ArcDPS. Restart the game after installing. Once loaded, arcdps.log shows "GW2 Overlay Bridge".

setup.intro: Go through these steps before using the overlay in the game. Each step is checked automatically, and the buttons fix what is missing. You can always come back via the "Get started" tab.
setup.dontShow: Don't show the guide at startup
setup.reopen: The guide always stays as a tab in the panel and in the tray menu.
setup.summary.warn: {n} steps are worth a look, but nothing blocks you.
setup.summary.bad: {n} steps must be fixed before the overlay works.
setup.key.title: Guild Wars 2 API key
setup.key.step1: Sign in at {link} with your game account.
setup.key.step2: Click "New Key", give it a name and tick all permissions.
setup.key.step3: Copy the key, paste it here and click "Save and test".
setup.key.missingRequired: The key for {name} lacks required permissions: {list}. Create a new key with all permissions.
setup.key.missingRecommended: The key for {name} works but lacks {list}. Some modules (Today, Trading Post, Characters, Guild) will be incomplete.
setup.key.ok: The key for {name} works and has all permissions.
setup.game.title: Game folder
setup.game.body: The folder containing Gw2-64.exe. Needed to install ArcDPS and the bridge.
setup.game.notFound: Gw2-64.exe not found. Start the game once, or pick the folder yourself.
setup.arc.title: ArcDPS and the bridge
setup.arc.body: ArcDPS provides DPS logs. The bridge is our small extension that streams buffs, debuffs and cooldowns live to the overlay. Both go into the game folder, and the game must be closed meanwhile.
setup.arc.arcOk: ArcDPS is installed and up to date.
setup.arc.checkFailed: Could not check against the publisher: {error}
setup.arc.done: ArcDPS and the bridge are installed.
setup.logs.title: ArcDPS log folder
setup.logs.body: ArcDPS saves boss fights in your Documents folder (often in OneDrive). The folder is created after the first logged fight, so it is fine if it is missing now.
setup.logs.missing: The folder {dir} does not exist yet. It appears after the first boss fight. If your logs live elsewhere, set the folder under Settings.
setup.startup.title: Start with the game
setup.startup.follow: Show the overlay only while the game is running
setup.startup.ok: The overlay starts with Windows, waits in the tray and appears when the game starts.
setup.startup.partial: Tick both so the overlay appears by itself when you start the game.
setup.helper.title: The helper (position and chat)
setup.helper.body: A small program bundled with the app reads character and map from the game (MumbleLink) and pastes waypoints into the chat.
setup.helper.error: The helper could not be started: {error}
setup.helper.ok: The helper is running and sees the game.
setup.helper.waiting: The helper is running. It sees the game once you are logged in on a character.

setup.ai.body: Inventory advice and character reviews use a model running locally in {link}, or a cloud provider (Google Gemini has a free tier) chosen under Settings. Without AI the rest of the overlay works as usual.

live.delayHelp: The evtc channel from ArcDPS arrives 2–3 seconds behind the game. Upkeep only blinks once a boon has been missing longer than this. Countdowns are unaffected, they are computed from the event's own time.
live.recordHelp: Debugging: writes everything the bridge sends during the next three minutes to a file in the log folder, with arrival time per line.
